CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub CasellaCombinata10_Change()
Me!MATERIALE.Enabled = True
Me!CODCF.Enabled = True


End Sub

Private Sub CasellaCombinata6_Change()
Me!CasellaCombinata8 = ""
     Me!CasellaCombinata8.Requery

     Me!CasellaCombinata10 = ""
     Me!CasellaCombinata10.RowSource = ""
     
     Me!MATERIALE.Enabled = False
     Me!CODCF.Enabled = False
     
End Sub

Private Sub CasellaCombinata8_Change()
 Me!CasellaCombinata10 = ""
     Me!CasellaCombinata10.RowSource = "SELECT [Mat-fornitori].CODCF FROM [Mat-fornitori]WHERE ((([Mat-fornitori].MATERIALE)=[Forms]![Mat-fornitori]![CasellaCombinata8]) AND (([Mat-fornitori].RAGSOC)=[Forms]![Mat-fornitori]![CasellaCombinata6]));"

          Me!CasellaCombinata10.Requery
     Me!MATERIALE.Enabled = False
     Me!CODCF.Enabled = False
End Sub
Private Sub MATERIALE_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_MATERIALE_Click

    Dim stDocName As String

    stDocName = "MatFornitoriMAT"
    DoCmd.RunMacro stDocName

Exit_MATERIALE_Click:
    Exit Sub

Err_MATERIALE_Click:
    MsgBox Err.Description
    Resume Exit_MATERIALE_Click
    
End Sub
Private Sub CODCF_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_CODCF_Click

    Dim stDocName As String

    stDocName = "MatFornitoriCODCF"
    DoCmd.RunMacro stDocName

Exit_CODCF_Click:
    Exit Sub

Err_CODCF_Click:
    MsgBox Err.Description
    Resume Exit_CODCF_Click
    
End Sub
